bounded_lifecycle.producer: Compiled map raw name, selected language lookup or basic MapInfos fallback
bounded_lifecycle.write: Successful PN expansion mutates whichever selected text is returned; each later lookup uses the then-current key/material
bounded_lifecycle.consumer: Map name/location notice, phone filters/text, roaming same-name gate, continue preview and metadata editor
bounded_lifecycle.display: Repeated reads can retain Alice after player changes to Bob; preview global player expansion can precede saved-player handling
bounded_lifecycle.persistence: Lookup only changes memory; language/metadata/basic-name reloads replace different material; later explicit metadata archive/PBS save can persist changed raw name
bounded_lifecycle.failure: Every lookup miss/ordinary-name/independent-material premise retained in canonical JXN001; lookup/type failures may precede mutation, later UI failure does not undo it; no default-demo accident claim

shared_contracts.independent_assessment: Selected text may mutate in memory; name query/preview are separated from explicit metadata archive/PBS save. WP63/roaming consumers still query/compare the map-name service; JXN vector premises fail independently of the supported main body.

bounded_lifecycle.producer: Wall/calendar clock, monotonic elapsed source, playtime accumulator and declared animation units
bounded_lifecycle.write: Playtime getter may update accumulated value and temporary anchor; timers retain distinct start/deadline/counter fields
bounded_lifecycle.consumer: Phone/berries/fishing/daycare, title/save/migration, special modes and presentation timelines
bounded_lifecycle.display: Timer display and stage eligibility use distinct flooring/strict comparisons; nominal units do not prove rendered frame counts
bounded_lifecycle.persistence: Accumulated playtime/system timer and domain timers persist; uptime anchors are reset or local as defined, no generic offline catch-up
bounded_lifecycle.failure: Backward clock, same second, zero start and negative remaining time have entry-specific behavior; M02-006 derived queries partial; local timing findings M10/M11 stay consumers

shared_contracts.independent_assessment: Private event seconds/days formulas and local registration state remain distinct from generic variable timer/playtime and runtime uptime; R5-U01 actual gate WAIT.

bounded_lifecycle.producer: Events, utility wrappers, lottery, minigame and debug/business writers
bounded_lifecycle.write: Raw variables retain false and map nil to public0; switches/raw truthiness differ from strict self-switch true; direct and convenience writes differ in refresh
bounded_lifecycle.consumer: Conditions, field tools, phone, timers, lottery outputs and scene refresh
bounded_lifecycle.display: Message substitutions and command branches read current values using their entry-specific rules
bounded_lifecycle.persistence: Variables/switches/self-switches saved as registered aggregates; event-private records separate
bounded_lifecycle.failure: ID0/negative/upper-bound and malformed-value gates are not uniform; sequential lottery same-ID outputs overwrite earlier results; M02-001 and M05-007 narrow gaps retained

shared_contracts.independent_assessment: Event-private keys, persistent A, tempA, raw switch slots and s: expression consumers are separately qualified; strict switch comparison nil differs from script nil Else.

bounded_lifecycle.producer: World map/screen/character/weather state and scene update order
bounded_lifecycle.consumer: Map display, shadows/reflections/grass/location notices and active world animations
bounded_lifecycle.display: Logical coordinates/tone/opacity/tile geometry matched; global pictures1–100 displayed while business domains split
bounded_lifecycle.persistence: Screen/picture/weather request data saved by system/screen owner; renderer objects rebuilt/transient
bounded_lifecycle.failure: Weather can reject new transition while screen retains request; same-type power not re-delivered; fog scroll/time M10-009 and source-animation012013 partial; actual pixels/GPU/context limits unresolved

shared_contracts.independent_assessment: Berry micro-update can change business/display state before choice return; visual mapping is static and no pixel/media runtime claim is signed.

bounded_lifecycle.write: Bound map/event identifiers, current-map lookups, private variables/self-switches, page and route state
bounded_lifecycle.consumer: Commands/conditions/trigger geometry, phone/event tools, map refresh and author-converted pages
bounded_lifecycle.display: Page graphic/direction/frame may be retained or reset under exact guards; message waits yield selectively
bounded_lifecycle.persistence: Events/map records and global private event values persist according to owning aggregate; interpreter active context separate
bounded_lifecycle.failure: M03 canonical identity/page/script-switch/cooldown/route gaps retained; true command return not business success; generated page conditions remain conjunctive; SyntaxError tool suggestion does not auto-launch native editor

shared_contracts.independent_assessment: Bound-map private/self-switch identity is separated from current-map command target identity, with main-end and follower exceptions; erase record key remains current map.

bounded_lifecycle.producer: Startup/continue, map factory, edge crossing and explicit transfer
bounded_lifecycle.write: Resident/current map and placement; enter clears local records then sets encounters/visited/trail/weather; scene refresh follows caller-specific placement
bounded_lifecycle.consumer: Events, encounter snapshots, roaming, vehicle state, spritesets and save recovery
bounded_lifecycle.display: Location names, tiles, character and weather views consume different snapshots
bounded_lifecycle.persistence: Map factory/player/global/map metadata saved separately; local record clear is not equivalent to rebuilding every resident instance
bounded_lifecycle.failure: Rebuild and reuse fail at different prefixes; map query can create state; missing map/demo records remain unavailable; canonical M03 narrow event/route gaps are separately routed

shared_contracts.independent_assessment: Clearing records on enter and restoration guards are retained; no generic full aggregate reset or new actual map integration claim.

bounded_lifecycle.producer: Movement request/completion, forced routes and field-action callers
bounded_lifecycle.write: Distance at request; ordinary counter modulo 2^31 before notifications; general-step and player-step dispatch differ; forced/interpreter completion skips ordinary counter
bounded_lifecycle.consumer: Repel snapshot/decrement, happiness, poison, daycare, hatching, radar, encounter and special-mode budgets
bounded_lifecycle.display: Terrain animation, hatch/battle/messages can yield to world updates
bounded_lifecycle.persistence: Counters in global metadata/stats; affected creatures in their current containers
bounded_lifecycle.failure: Callbacks may stop after distance/count writes; forced completion can cause two general notifications; diagonal/zero-jump and route-install gaps retain M03 canonical conditions

shared_contracts.independent_assessment: Inherited diagonal displacement has no player four-way distance/effects; normal four-way/nonzero jump comparisons and ordinary/global step distinctions retained.

bounded_lifecycle.write: Map identity/residence, player/follower coordinates, vehicle state and local records in caller-specific order
bounded_lifecycle.consumer: Enter/leave subscribers, encounters/roamers, restored events, visuals and save
bounded_lifecycle.display: Notification can precede explicit placement but follow edge placement; camera/scene rebuild distinct
bounded_lifecycle.persistence: Map/player/global state aggregates preserve selected fields; facility temporarily substitutes map for save then normal restore
bounded_lifecycle.failure: Same-ID rebuild not a no-op; entry failure can leave prefix; explicit transfer doesn't imply clearing existing movement timers or all surfing flags; pending routes/follower identity retain M03 exceptions

shared_contracts.independent_assessment: Resident connected-map example is a source-static premise; direct route/location branches do not assert complete transfer or map/media reachability.

bounded_lifecycle.producer: Main map loop, micro-update helpers, message waits and scene transitions
bounded_lifecycle.write: Interpreter/event/movement/clock/visual state in different update subsets
bounded_lifecycle.consumer: Phone/berries/timers, input queues, camera/animations and waiting callers
bounded_lifecycle.display: Micro-updates may continue map objects while main interpreter is suspended; fade gates matter
bounded_lifecycle.persistence: Business state may become saved; local update/input clocks runtime
bounded_lifecycle.failure: No universal paused-world assumption during UI; berry cancellation does not freeze growth; timing/input ordering M10/M11 consumer findings and M03 route gates remain distinct

shared_contracts.independent_assessment: Main interpreter wait, scene micro-update and loaded berry eligibility differ; cancellation does not freeze time and route stop thresholds are seconds, not promised frames.
